title: Definition.
bodyText: In this chapter, "felony" means an offense that is punishable with imprisonment for a term which is in excess of one year.
bodyHtml: §831-1  Definition.  In this chapter, "felony" means an offense that is punishable with imprisonment for a term which is in excess of one year. [L 1969, c 250, pt of §1; HRS §716-1; ren L 1972, c 9, pt of §1; am L 1975, c 14, §1]
